title: Hunger for Hand-Drawn Art
content: Children’s book illustratorShirley Hughes, in her memoirA Life Drawing, reflects on the importance of book illustrations in the lives of young people growing up without much other hand-drawn art around them:“It may be that picture books offer the only drawn imagery that some children will really come to grips with. They have such good visual memories, far better than most adults. It may be someone’s only glimpse of the work of someone’s hand.”
